purpose: Original wall base-color textures for Gallerify. Each image represents 2 × 2 meters. Image binaries are hosted in Cloudflare R2; retired texture images are removed from Git.

assets.name: Chalk plaster
assets.prompt: Use case: photorealistic-natural. Asset type: seamless square base-color texture for a 3D art gallery wall. Create one production-quality 1024x1024 material texture, a straight-on orthographic scan of a 2 meter by 2 meter surface, filling the entire square edge to edge. Material: clean chalk-white painted fine plaster, warm-neutral near-white, tiny irregular mineral grain and extremely subtle roller stipple, matte museum wall, mostly smooth with delicate realistic microtexture. Physically believable fine surface detail, understated and appropriate as a backdrop for artworks. Perfectly flat diffuse illumination and consistent average color across the whole image, no baked directional light, no cast shadows, no highlights, no vignette, no gradients. Seamlessly tileable horizontally and vertically; opposite edges must match, fine stochastic detail with no obvious recurring focal marks. No room, corners, wall edges, floor, objects, border, text, labels, watermark, damage, cracks, stains, or dramatic cloudy patches. The output is ONLY the material surface.
